scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** CI starts on a clean supported Linux runner
- **THEN** browser and host dependencies are installed before the smoke command and no missing local WebKit dependency is treated as a skip
scenarios.id: cross-browser-smoke::CI runs smoke with browser prerequisites::Clean CI runner
scenarios.name: Clean CI runner
scenarios.requirement: CI runs smoke with browser prerequisites
scenarios.requirementContent: CI SHALL run the three-browser smoke suite in a separate job on pull requests to main and pushes to main. That job SHALL install the pinned dependency tree, all three browser binaries, and their Linux host dependencies. A smoke failure SHALL fail its job; full Chromium browser and visual tests SHALL continue in their existing job.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** any smoke test fails
- **THEN** the smoke job reports failure independently of the full Chromium suite

scenarios.name: Smoke failure is visible
scenarios.requirement: CI runs smoke with browser prerequisites
scenarios.requirementContent: CI SHALL run the three-browser smoke suite in a separate job on pull requests to main and pushes to main. That job SHALL install the pinned dependency tree, all three browser binaries, and their Linux host dependencies. A smoke failure SHALL fail its job; full Chromium browser and visual tests SHALL continue in their existing job.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a developer lists the default suite after smoke support is added
- **THEN** it contains the same Chromium test identities as before and no Firefox or WebKit projects
scenarios.id: cross-browser-smoke::Full Chromium regression coverage is preserved::Default suite is inspected
scenarios.name: Default suite is inspected
scenarios.requirement: Full Chromium regression coverage is preserved
scenarios.requirementContent: The default browser test command SHALL retain the entire Chromium suite, including the seven smoke scenarios and all existing visual tests, with unchanged snapshot identities.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a developer lists the smoke suite
- **THEN** the listing contains the same seven scenario identities for each browser and no visual snapshot tests
scenarios.id: cross-browser-smoke::Shared bounded functional smoke coverage::Smoke selection is inspected
scenarios.name: Smoke selection is inspected
scenarios.requirementContent: The smoke command SHALL run exactly seven shared functional scenarios in each of Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit (21 executions). The scenarios SHALL cover Input native value/events, Checkbox native lifecycle, Select keyboard selection and focus restoration, Modal focus containment and Escape, Popover dismissal and state synchronization, Date Picker keyboard dismissal/commit and accessibility, and File Upload selection/drop/disabled/consumer rendering. These SHALL reuse the full suite's test bodies without browser-specific skips or reduced assertions and SHALL NOT compare screenshots.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the smoke command runs with all browser prerequisites installed
- **THEN** all seven scenarios execute in each of the three engines and any failed scenario makes the command fail
scenarios.id: cross-browser-smoke::Shared bounded functional smoke coverage::Three-engine smoke execution
scenarios.name: Three-engine smoke execution
scenarios.requirementContent: The smoke command SHALL run exactly seven shared functional scenarios in each of Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit (21 executions). The scenarios SHALL cover Input native value/events, Checkbox native lifecycle, Select keyboard selection and focus restoration, Modal focus containment and Escape, Popover dismissal and state synchronization, Date Picker keyboard dismissal/commit and accessibility, and File Upload selection/drop/disabled/consumer rendering. These SHALL reuse the full suite's test bodies without browser-specific skips or reduced assertions and SHALL NOT compare screenshots.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the smoke checkout finishes and dependency, build, or test commands run
- **THEN** checkout authentication credentials are not retained in local Git configuration
scenarios.id: cross-browser-smoke::Smoke checkout credentials are not persisted::Repository commands run after checkout
scenarios.name: Repository commands run after checkout
scenarios.requirement: Smoke checkout credentials are not persisted
scenarios.requirementContent: The smoke job SHALL use checkout without persisting its authentication token or SSH key in local Git configuration for subsequent repository-controlled commands.
